(CAR), SMVDU, Katra
Research Project entitled-“To Restraint or Regulate the Reproductive Health Issues of Human from Jammu
and Kashmir Region”

Terms and condition
 All applicants must have at least 5 years to superannuate.
 The post is to be filled up only on purely temporary basis and will be for the duration of the project
with continuation being granted every year based on performance.
 The appointment can be terminated with one-month notice from either side without assigning any
reason.
 Since the post is purely temporary, the incumbents selected will have no claim for regular
appointments under ICMR or continuation of his/her services in any other project.
 All appointed staff shall ensure that the data reaches the central coordinating unit regularly with
development of data analysis plan, data management and analysis andcoordinate the disbursement of
budget to the centers.
 Benefits of HRA and Travel etc. are only applicable for scientist ‘B’ position.
 No TA/DA etc. will be given to attend Interview or joining of the post and candidate should make
his/her own arrangement for stay and travel.
 Experience will be counted only after completion of essential educational qualification.
 Mere fulfilling the essential qualification does not guarantee call for the interview and/or selection.
 Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
 Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department /Organization are
not eligible to apply.
 The selected candidate will work in the center mentioned above, and on any other work that may be
assigned by the Principal Investigator from time to time.
 Application must be submitted in the given format (Annexure I) and application in any other format
will be rejected.
All application must be sent to the following email id: icmr.car@smvdu.ac.in
Those who have applied earlier need not to apply again.
Date of Interview will be communicated to the eligible candidates through email/phone only and no enquiry
in this regard will be entertained.
Note: The application sent by will have to be accompanied by a duly signed hard copy along with necessary
documents so as to reach SMVDU on or before last date at the following address:
Dr. Rakesh Kumar
PI-CAR-ICMR Project
School of Biotechnology
SMVD University
Kakryl-182320
Katra, J&K
On-line applications alone will not be considered.
Last Date for submitting applications is 21 days from the date of advertisement published in local
newspapers.
Further information on CAR-ICMR-SMVDU and its Mission/Function can be viewed on the SMVDU website
(www.smvdu.ac.in).
Ref. No.: SMVDU/IRDU/19/061, Dated: 23rd May, 2019
Dr. Rakesh Kumar
Sd/- Principal Investigator
CAR-ICMR-SMVDU.
